Pacijent sam klinike Milmedika već 16–17 godina, a tokom svih tih godina njihovu brigu i stručnost upoznala je i moja porodica. Moja djeca danas imaju 9, 14 i 17 godina i sve troje su kod njih praćeni od rođenja.

Ono što ovu kliniku izdvaja jeste spoj izuzetne stručnosti i iskreno pažljivog odnosa prema pacijentu. Termin se dobija brzo, čekanje je kratko, a od trenutka kada uđete osjećate se dobrodošlo, uvaženo i saslušano. Čak i jednostavno pitanje „Kako ste danas?“ ovdje nije puka formalnost.

Ljekari su vrhunski stručnjaci i profesionalci kojima vjerujem godinama. Posebnu zahvalnost dugujem medicinskim sestrama i cijelom osoblju — njihov trud, ljubaznost i briga čine srce ove klinike.

Milmediku od srca preporučujem svima koji traže kvalitetnu zdravstvenu njegu i ljude kojima mogu da vjeruju.

I have been a patient at Milmedika for 16–17 years, and over that time my whole family has experienced their care and expertise. My children are now 9, 14 and 17, and all three have been cared for by the clinic since birth.

What sets this clinic apart is the combination of excellent medical care and genuine kindness. Appointments are easy to arrange, waiting times are short, and from the moment you walk in, you feel welcome, respected and listened to. Even a simple “How are you today?” feels sincere.

The doctors are highly skilled professionals whom I have trusted for years. I am equally grateful to the nurses and the entire support team — their dedication, warmth and care are truly the heart of this clinic.

I wholeheartedly recommend Milmedika to anyone looking for excellent healthcare and people they can trust.

Sve preporuke za Milmediku, a posebno za Filipa! Zaista jedno od najboljih iskustava koje sam ikada imala u zdravstvenoj ustanovi. Od prvog trenutka sve je bilo na najvisem nivou - profesionalnost, ljubaznost, organizacija i odnos prema pacijentu.

Filip zasluzuje posebnu pohvalu. Izuzetno strucan, pazljiv, smiren i posvecen, sa pristupom zbog kojeg se odmah osjecate sigurno i opusteno. Sve objasni jasno, ima strpljenja za svako pitanje i vidi se da mu je zaista stalo do pacijenta i do toga da sve bude uradjeno kako treba. Takav spoj strucnosti, profesionalnosti i ljudskosti se zaista rijetko srece.

Kompletno iskustvo u Milmedici bilo je besprekorno i zaista nemam nijednu zamjerku. Sve je bilo sjajno od pocetka do kraja i definitivno bih ih preporucila svakome. Filipu Medvidovicu  posebno jedno ogromno hvala - kada naidjete na nekoga ko svoj posao radi sa toliko paznje i posvecenosti, to se pamti. Cista desetka! ❤️

The staff are rude. I was waiting on the doctor's side, I'm a patient. They said there was another patient with an appointment. I said okay. Of course, they'll go in before me. But they made me get up from where I was sitting. By what right?! How rude! The reason was so the patient before me could sit down. And you're not even a doctor, yet you're shamelessly asking for a blood test. I got up and left. You're a complete money trap. May God not let anyone fall into your hands. This happens even before you go to the doctor.

Ich hatte ein gesundheitliches Problem und habe mich für diese Klinik entschieden.
Mir wurde an der Rezeption direkt ein Termin bei einer Fachärztin am folgenden Tag gegeben und die Preise in Euro für die Behandlung genannt. Im gleichen Schritt wurde ich nebenan ins Labor geschickt, um eine notwendige blutbrobe machen zu lassen. Ich bin direkt dran gekommen und musste nicht warten. Das Ergebnis wurde 2 std später per Mail gesendet.
Der Termin bei der Fachärztin am nächsten Tag war pünktlich und wir mussten nur 7 min warten. Hier hat sich sogar das Personal bei uns  entschuldigt. Die Ärztin hat sich sehr viel Zeit genommen und mich professionell untersucht.
Das Personal in der Klinik und im Labor waren super freundlich, zuvorkommend und haben einen geholfen.
Ich kann diese Klinik sehr empfehlen! Es war alles Bestens, sauber und professionell!
Ich würde bei einem Problem definitiv wieder kommen!
Vielen Dank

Overall, I had mixed feelings about this laboratory.

We came with our infant, and there was a sign stating that elderly people, people with disabilities, pregnant women, and parents with young children have priority service. Despite that, we waited in the regular queue at the reception. When it was finally our turn, the receptionist asked us to wait so she could register an elderly woman first. After that, she was about to continue serving other people as well. I had to remind her that we had already waited in line, and only then did she register us.

On the positive side, the technician who took the blood sample was very professional and gentle. The procedure was quick, which is especially important with a small baby. We also received the test results within just a few minutes.

Während unseres Urlaubs in Montenegro bekam meine Frau eine starke Blasenentzündung. Aufgrund ihrer Schwangerschaft haben wir eine Klinik gesucht und sind schlussendlich hier fündig geworden. Man hat uns herzlich empfangen, ohne zu zögern unterstützt und sehr kompetent (in gutem Englisch) diagnostiziert. Ein großes Blutbild, kurzfristige und sehr schnelle Arztgespräche und die richtige Diagnose (auch basierend auf telefonischer Rücksprache mit der deutschen Frauenärztin unsererseits im Nachgang) haben einen super Eindruck hinterlassen. Sehr professionell und Patientenfreundlich. 73€ standen nach ca. 1,5h zu Buche - dafür gab es ein hohes Maß an Kompetenz wie es in Deutschland in der Kürze der Zeit wohl kaum noch zu finden ist. Klare Empfehlung. Vielen Dank für Eure Hilfe.
We received excellent medical care from Dr. Radojka Lekic at Milmedika. Excellent professionals.

Izuzetno neprofesionalno i neljubazno osoblje na telefonu! Prilikom pokušaja zakazivanja pregleda kod dr Dobričanina, zaposlena radnica je bila nekulturna i bukvalno se smijala tokom razgovora. Nedopustivo ponašanje za jednu privatnu zdravstvenu ustanovu. Ako je ljekar stručnjak, osoblje na prijemu bi moralo da prati taj nivo profesionalizma. Podgorica je u pitanju.
Very professional medical service, great and kind personal with high level of empathy, rare to find in this times.

Since years, I haven’t had such a good experience as here. From the highly qualified team and quick assistance to accurate diagnosis and a great atmosphere, everything stands out.

It’s clear that people enjoy working here, which creates a welcoming and reassuring environment.

I’ve lived my whole life in the EU, but here, instead of giving unnecessary prescriptions, they genuinely focus on providing the best possible care.
